questions.text:
Hi <!subteam^S0APEMVA8LQ>! I need help getting a Salesforce Partner Business Org (PBO) provisioned.
*Context:* I'm adding Merge default credentials for the Agent Handler Salesforce connector. Today our client app would have to live in our corporate RevOps Salesforce org, which makes our production CRM a permanent dependency of the product — that org could never be migrated or consolidated without breaking every customer who installed our package. A PBO is Salesforce's intended home for this and removes the dependency entirely. There is no upfront license cost for a base PBO.
I've completed a full proof of concept end to end, so the build steps and config are already validated. I just need your help setting up the account registration under the right team credentials.
*What I need help with:*
1. *Determine the Team Email Alias:* We need to choose a team distribution list or alias (e.g., `<mailto:salesforce-devs@merge.dev|salesforce-devs@merge.dev>` or `<mailto:partnerships@merge.dev|partnerships@merge.dev>`) to register the account. We should *not* use individual personal emails or our main production CRM admin accounts.
2. *Enroll at <http://salesforce.com|salesforce.com>:* Click *Become a Salesforce Partner* and create a new Salesforce Username using that team alias. Select *ISV* as the partner type.
3. *Accept the Click-Through Agreement:* The first time you log into the newly created account, Salesforce will show a standard, full-screen click-through agreement (the SPPA) to verify the portal access. It just requires a simple checkbox confirmation on the screen to pass.
4. *Log a Help Case:* Once inside the portal, log a support case with the subject _"Requesting Partner Business Org (PBO)"_. In the description, explicitly request a *completely new, clean environment* to host our agreement.
Please let me know if I should clarify anything :slightly_smiling_face:
questions.rationale: Detailed partner-org setup requiring internal credential decisions and manual portal case logging.
